sag.blurb: Locked in as the chart of the United States. Jupiter — exalted in Cancer — rules the nation, and Saturn is exalted too: both of the country's societal planets at their finest tools. The Cancer stellium falls in the 8th house — other people's money, debt, the reserve currency, death & rebirth: the faith-and-finance empire. Chosen over July 4 because its Moon is a live Capricorn (conjunct Pluto, on the people-vs-government axis), not Sibley's void Aquarius.
